content:
claire: Quick sync: we're co-hosting a partner showcase with CloudArc + EdgeWorks on Oct 4 (30m micro-sessions + 15m live Q&A). Need final speakers, a demo fallback ladder, and a contactless "vending tower" swag plan. Who picks what?
dan: I can own speaker confirmations and collect bios/headshots. Can we lock names by Mon EOD?
marta: Marketing will do landing page + promo cadence. Need 1-line speaker blurbs + headshots by Thu. Also want a small CTA on the promo to sign up for the hands-on session.
pete: Ops here. I'll own demo ops and vending tower logistics. Primary demo on EdgeWorks private cluster; fallback 1 = local CPU container; fallback 2 = 90s video + slides. For swag, vendor offers a "SmartTower" contactless dispenser we can preload and unlock via QR codes.
claire: SmartTower sounds neat. Proposal: each registrant gets a single-use QR that redeems at the tower for one swag pack. Tower will be at Booth D2, staffed 30m before/after session. Agree to 1-per-reg?
dan: Yes to 1-per-reg. Also include a promo card inside so we can tie conversions to the session.
marta: Volunteer plan: 09:30-10:30 lead @pete, 10:30-11:15 backup @claire. Can CloudArc provide one volunteer for overflow?
pete: CloudArc confirmed Maya as overflow. I'll ship swag to vendor warehouse Sep 30. Need exact tower capacity; vendor says ~180 small packages. If more, we'll run a staffed table fallback.
ops-bot: calendar: "Partner Showcase: CloudArc + EdgeWorks" Oct 4 10:00-10:45 PT. Dry run Oct 2 09:00 PT. Links added.
claire: Fallback script for moderator: 1) call primary EdgeWorks cluster 2) if errors after 45s, announce switch to local container 3) if still failing, play 90s walkthrough video and pivot to live Q&A. Keep handoff lines short and friendly.
dan: For the SmartTower QR flow: attendee receives unique QR on registration; vendor app scans and releases a single package. We'll test full flow in dry run. @pete can you coordinate a test with vendor?
pete: Yes. I'll schedule a vendor test during the dry run and bring spare phone + mini router. Also packing list draft below: 
```n- 150 mini-sticker bundles
- 60 USB-C dongles (preloaded image)
- 30 pocket dev kits
- 160 one-sheet quickstarts
```
I'll add weights/dims and courier labels tonight.
marta: Run-of-show: slides due Sep 25, speaker dry run Oct 2, final PDF Oct 3. Promo blasts: Sep 12 initial, Sep 26 reminder, Oct 1 final. Legal: avoid explicit latency/cost numbers unless cleared.
claire: AV & tech: 1x HDMI input, spare HDMI-to-USB capture, wired ethernet recommended, mic lav for moderator. Bring 2x HDMI adapters and a 5m HDMI cable.
dan: Also please ensure we have a short recorded clip hosted on S3 (private link) for fallback. Keep it under 100MB for quick buffering.
pete: I'll prepare a lightweight CPU demo image that boots in <45s and a 90s MP4 on S3. I'll also label each swag pack with a manifest ID for inventory.
ops-bot: reminder: Dry run scheduled Oct 2 09:00 PT. Auto-invite sent to participants.
marta: Final checklist: 1) speaker names + bios by Mon, 2) manifest + weights by Sep 30, 3) slides by Sep 25, 4) dry run Oct 2. I'll DM owners and post the landing page draft when ready. Thanks team :tada:
